details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: --delete scope expansion by a malicious sender
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53789.patch: downgrade implied-parent
       directories to FLAG_IMPLIED_DIR on the receiver, covering synthetic and
       legacy implied parents, so a sender cannot mark a parent as a content
       dir and have delete_in_dir() sweep pre-existing siblings. The
       parse_filter_file() module-dir strip that upstream bundled into the
       same commit is not taken here: it is the CVE-2026-53786 fix per
       upstream NEWS and ships in debian/patches/CVE-2026-53786.patch
     - the patch's two regression tests are rewritten against this tree's shell
       testsuite, as upstream's pytest-based ones need a harness 3.2.3 does not
       have; debian/control gains python3 <!nocheck> in Build-Depends for them
     - CVE-2026-53789
